dedupe_keys.name: ramc risk aware model then control for predictive thermal control of buildings

description: Nima Monghasemi and colleagues at Mälardalen University publish RAMC, which trains building thermal models with a conditional-value-at-risk penalty before nonlinear predictive control. The August 2026 archive provides Python code, processed data, weather and identified resistance-capacitance parameters. Its case adapts a DOE retail-building prototype to hydronic district heating in Västerås, Sweden. MIT terms cover author code; redistributed prototype and weather inputs retain their own conditions. Downloads are free. The workflow supports simulation of risk-sensitive heating control, identification and held-out validation. EnergyPlus 25.1 is needed to regenerate initial outputs; later stages can read deposited data, and a large neural-training table must be regenerated. Related catalogue records model-energyplus and data-doe-pnnl-prototype-building-models describe dependencies. Transfer to actual buildings, parameter uncertainty and reported cost performance were not independently assessed. No code or control experiment was run.
